I think you might be taking these delivery pod components a little too linear and specific. I think you need to break these into subcomponents. For example, there is a role, which is a rectangle shape. It has a name, a background color, and a font color. In some cases, you might need the font color to be different from the default because the background color might require something different for contrast.
You can see here that we laid out different semantic components. There is a pod group with many role components inside it, defining lead roles and engineer roles. The number of roles in a pod will vary every single time, and there is no really good standard definition of a pod that you could use to say, “There are always two roles in here.”
I think you could break this into:
- A basic building block component, the role definition, which has the shape, a role name, a background color, and that sort of thing.
- A pod definition, which has a shape and role components inside it.
You might need to make that a multi-column pod. There might be pods with enough role definitions to fit in a single column, and some might need multiple columns, so the height will be different. This needs to be put together more dynamically than the way you're describing these components articulates it.
